# Product Requirements Document (PRD)

## Problem & Background
Summarize the problem being solved and why it matters.

## Product Intent & Objectives
List key goals and target capabilities.

## Non-Goals (Explicit Exclusions)
Explicitly document what is OUT of scope to prevent scope creep.

## User Persona & Acceptance Criteria
- **User Flow**: High-level interaction flow.
- **Acceptance Criteria**: Verifiable criteria for completion.

## User Feedback, Error States & Recovery
- **Action Feedback**: Visual pending indicators (disabled button, loading spinner) and success/error notifications (toasts or banners with retry) for every mutation.
- **Form Validation**: Accessible inline error messages adjacent to inputs.
- **Data State Specifications**: Clear requirements for loading skeletons, empty states, and error recovery states.
